'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Pokrovsk offensive]]
****[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] officials order the immediate evacuation of the remaining 53,000 citizens in [[Pokrovsk, Ukraine|Pokrovsk]] due to the advancement of the [[Russian Armed Forces]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/19/ukraine-orders-families-to-leave-key-city-of-pokrovsk-amid-russian-advances (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Russia]] captures the city of [[Zalizne]] and the [[Vyimka]] railway station in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-forces-capture-town-zalizne-ukraines-east-defence-ministry-says-2024-08-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[Belarusian involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Belarus]] announces that it has further increased its [[Belarus–Ukraine border]] presence against [[Ukraine]] significantly, adding [[aircraft]] and [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defense forces]] following its accusations of [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukraine's military]] sending 120,000 troops to its border and conducting "aggressive policies". Ukraine denies Lukashenko's claims, stating its forces have not observed unusual movements of Belarusian troops on the border. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belarus-says-it-sends-more-troops-aircraft-armoury-border-with-ukraine-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**An [[Israel]]i soldier is killed and several others are injured in [[Hezbollah]] rocket launches at [[IDF]] positions in [[Ya'ara]] and Biyadh Blida, with [[Burkan-2|Burkan missiles]] and drone strikes in [[Galilee|Western Galilee]] being intercepted by the [[Iron Dome]]. Hezbollah claims that it attacked and repelled Israeli soldiers attempting to infiltrate [[southern Lebanon]] through the Hadab Aita forest and had inflicted casualties. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/19/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-forces-invade-khan-younis-deir-el-balah (Al Jazeera)] 
**Two Hezbollah militants are killed in Israeli airstrikes on Hezbollah infrastructure in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/19/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-forces-invade-khan-younis-deir-el-balah (Al Jazeera)]
**Eight civilians are injured in an Israeli airstrike on a [[Hezbollah]] weapons facility in the eastern [[Beqaa Valley]] of [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-targets-hezbollah-arms-depot-lebanons-bekaa-valley-security-2024-08-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Three [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] and five [[Pakistani Taliban]] gunmen are killed during a [[shootout]] in [[Bajaur District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-afghanistan-militant-attack-border-53beb5b36bd4341f06a354efbdf6a296 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Maria Branyas]], the former world's [[List of oldest living people|oldest known living person]], dies at the age of 117 years and 168 days, making [[Tomiko Itooka]] the new current oldest living person. [https://apnews.com/article/oldest-person-japan-guinness-records-0ee529d0fe6490143cc878a85bdf05cc (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Two people are killed by [[flood|flooding]] in [[Oxford, Connecticut|Oxford]], [[Connecticut]], [[United States]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2024/08/18/us/connecticut-flooding-rescues (CNN)]
*One person is killed and fifteen others are rescued when the [[United Kingdom]]-flagged [[superyacht]] ''[[Bayesian (yacht)|Bayesian]]'' sinks near [[Palermo]], [[Italy]], due to a [[waterspout]]. Six others remain missing, including British entrepreneur [[Mike Lynch (businessman)|Mike Lynch]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-sicily-storm-tourists-missing-060bf26f426708c8eb59e81d88787d11 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2024 mpox epidemic]]
**[[Pakistan]] reports a case of [[mpox]] in [[Kashmir]], bringing the total number of cases in the country to four. In response to the rapid increase of cases in the country, [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Prime Minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] announces that the country will begin [[Screening (medicine)|screening]] people at entry points. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/mpox-case-found-in-pakistan-occupied-kashmir-4th-case-in-pakistan-101724083924845.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.firstpost.com/world/pakistan-reports-4th-mpox-case-pm-sharif-orders-screening-at-all-entry-points-13806249.html/amp (Firstpost)]
**The [[Philippine]] [[Department of Health (Philippines)|Department of Health]] reports its first case of mpox this year in a patient with no international travel history. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/917530/doh-mpox-case/story/?amp (GMA Network)]
**Health officials in [[Tainan City]], [[Taiwan]], report that they have confirmed three cases of mpox so far this year. [https://news.tvbs.com.tw/english/2589492?from=english_content_pack (TVBS Taiwan)]

'''Law and crime'''
*One person is killed and eight injured during a [[mass shooting]] against a vehicle carrying migrants in [[Tubutama]], [[Sonora]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-migrants-attacked-shooting-arizona-border-47db874ee3d0e10b1eafdfcad00889ae (AP)]
*[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a decree making it easier for foreign nationals who support "[[Traditionalist conservatism|traditional values]]" and "oppose [[neoliberalism]]" to [[Asylum seeker|seek asylum]] in [[Russia]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/russia-to-offer-sanctuary-to-refugees-from-neoliberal-values/3307891 (Anadolu Agency)]
*Former [[United States House of Representatives|US Representative]] [[George Santos]] pleads guilty to [[wire fraud]] and aggravated [[identity theft]], which will carry a sentence of at least two years. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/expelled-former-rep-santos-plead-guilty-corruption-charges-source-says-2024-08-19/ (Reuters)]

*A rocket engine for [[Rocket Factory Augsburg]]'s [[launch vehicle]] ''RFA One'' explodes during a test launch at the [[SaxaVord Spaceport]] in [[Scotland]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy54wqzz0kvo (BBC News)]
*A rare [[blue moon|blue]] [[supermoon]] appears in the sky. [https://www.axios.com/2024/08/20/blue-moon-photos-full-moon-supermoon-august-2024 (Axios)]
